$comment: VAPP-92: the RECIPE contract. A theme styles a component PART under a `when` selector (the node's recipe props + the interaction `state`); this file fixes what a theme may name. `states` = the interaction states a painter reports (`default` is the absence of all; round 1 adds `invalid` = a field whose checks failed, `dragover` = a drop zone a drag hovers); `keys` = the whitelist a recipe style may set: a SUBSET of style.json's visual keys plus the padding/gap/size keys a part's box needs and `native` (true = the painter may use the platform's own control for this part, geometry still from the tokens); round 1 lets a recipe set `transition`/`transitionEasing` (so a theme's motion tokens finally animate hover/press/open), `transform` (a chevron that rotates when `open`), `borderStyle`, the four per-side border widths (an app bar's bottom rule, a tab bar's top rule), `textDecoration`, `letterSpacing`, `fontStyle`, `textTransform`. A part-level discriminator the painter supplies per drawn piece: CodeBlock/token `kind` (the codeToken enum), Table/headerCell+cell `align` and Table/row `striped` (true on ODD rows of a striped table), Table/row+cell `total` (true on the sum row of a `totals` table), Stepper's step `status` (a macro `$recipe`). `native` lists every native component's PARTS (the painter paints each part with its resolved recipe) and the PROPS a `when` may key on (the component's enum/boolean props; the catalog default fills an unset one, so a theme always sees a concrete value; a part-level discriminator the PAINTER supplies is listed too, see below). Macro parts come from macros.json (every template `part`) and their `when` props from the macro's `recipeProps` (+ a part's `$recipe` keys); src/recipes.ts derives them. Both lists are append-only. Round 2 (docs/round-2-contract.md §6): `parts` lists EVERY part a painter lays out (the conformance dump names each `<node id>.<part>[.<index or row key>]`), so the layout-only parts are here too (Switch/body, Radio/items, Slider/header, Table/body, CodeBlock/body+code, FileUpload/title+browse+fileIcon, the fields' `input`, Tooltip/anchor, Accordion/count, List/section, Carousel/controls+previous+next); keys add `backdropBlur` (`$blur.*`) and `animation`; Resizable is new. EXP-1259: SearchList is new (its parts are also a searchable Menu submenu's: head, search, count, list, empty, fade), Tabs gain `close` + `new` (props `closable`, `addable`), Skeleton gains its rows (`row`, `dot`, `bar`). EXP-1324: CodeBlock gains the `variant` (default|destructive) and `size` (default|sm) props, shadcn's code-block. VAPP-162 (docs/round-5-contract.md): Segmented gains `orientation` + the `badge` part (an option `count`), VoiceWave the `variant` prop + the `bar` part (the `bars` meter), QrCode and QrScanner are new. EXP-1495 (docs/round-6-contract.md): Carousel gains `counter` (prop + part) and the `thumbnails` strip (parts `thumbnails`, `thumbnail`, state `selected` = the current page). EXP-1586: ZoomableImage is new (the picture `image` + THE zoom pill: `pill`, `zoomOut`, `percent`, `zoomIn`, `divider`, `fit`; `fit` reports `selected` while the view is at rest). Switch gains `size` (default|compact: the dense in-row switch, a 28×16 track under a 12px thumb). #VAPP-258 (fixtures/markdown-render.json): a Markdown fenced block whose fence names a catalog/code.json language (not `plain` or `ansi`) paints CodeBlock's tokens (`tokenizeCode`) in the COLOUR its `CodeBlock/token {kind}` rule gives each kind, the colour only: its font, padding, background and so its height stay `Markdown/codeBlock`'s. #VAPP-258 (the app's Markdown on genUI): Markdown gains `headerCell` (a table's header cells), `chip` + `chipLabel` (an inline host chip's box and label, painted OVER the Chip/root + Chip/label look: a theme restyles the Markdown chip without touching every Chip) and two painter-supplied discriminators: a heading's `level` (1-6, a number) and a chip part's `chip` (its host kind: issue, mention, entity); `density` is always concrete on a part (`document` when the host sets none). Then: Markdown gains `cell` (a table's body cells; its paddings are every cell's, header included, unless `headerCell` sets its own) and `chipIdent` (a chip's `ident`, painted before its label); keys gain `marginTop` / `marginBottom`, which every renderer honours on `Markdown/heading` (per `level`) and `Markdown/listItem` (adjacent margins COLLAPSE to the larger, as CSS block margins do; a list's last item collapses with the block gap) and nowhere else on the natives. Round 8 (docs/round-8-contract.md): Canvas is new (`root`, prop `fit`; its shapes and text take no recipe: their colours are `$color` tokens in the drawing); Checkbox gains the `indeterminate` when-prop (on every part: `box` paints the CHECKED look under `indeterminate: true` whatever `checked`, and its `check` part holds the dash `ui-minus` instead of the tick `ui-check`); the Progress macro gains the `header` row, the `value` text (its `valueText`) and the `detail` caption, the Stepper macro the `full` wrapper and the `compact` line (its `collapse`), all macro parts (macros.json; the neutral theme colours `value` and `detail` mutedForeground). Round 9 (docs/round-9-contract.md §6.6, §9.1, fixtures/interactions-round1.json `checkSeverities`, fixtures/markdown-inline.json): states gain `warning` and `info` (a field's `error` part showing an advisory check: the `invalid` state stays for `error` alone), every checkable field gains the `error` part, Markdown gains the `profile` and `variant` when-props. #EXP-1629: Select gains the `value` part (the chosen text in the trigger) and the `chevron` part (the trigger glyph: `Select.trigger`, or `Select.chevron` on a row) on every variant, and the `triggerVariant` when-prop: a `row` trigger IS a Group row (no fill or border of its own), the `label` part leading INSIDE it, `value` (else `placeholder`) trailing end-aligned and truncated, then the chevron; the row's `label`, a flexible spacer, the `value` (else `placeholder`, at most the layout's `selectRowValueMaxWidth`, truncated) and the `chevron` are its parts, and its popup hangs off the VALUE: under it by `selectRowPopupOffset`, aligned `start` with it, the layout's `selectRowPopupWidth` wide unless `align`/`popupWidth` say otherwise, fitted into the host's window (not the surface) `selectRowPopupMargin` from its edges. Every Select popup opens with its list at the TOP and the keyboard cursor on the first enabled option (a fresh pick, the IDE's picker), focus in its search field when searchable; an item's `hover` state = the cursor (the pointer moves it: one highlight), `selected` = chosen, and a chosen item shows the trailing `check`. Then: keys gain `backgroundClip` (`border-box` default | `padding-box`: the fill paints INSIDE the border, so a translucent border blends over what is behind the box, gpui-component's quad; a recipe key only, never a Box style), Select gains SearchList's `fade` (the list's bottom `searchListFade` fades out while more options sit below its visible end) and the exponential theme's row popup takes `backgroundClip: padding-box` and `$shadow.popover`. #EXP-1629: Input gains the `variant` when-prop: a `row` field IS a Group row (no fill, border or focus chrome of its own), the `label` part leading INSIDE it (never shrinking), the typed text end-aligned filling the rest at 70% of the field's colour (the Group row's value tone; the placeholder keeps its own). #EDE-65: keys gain `borderTopLeftRadius` (`$radius`/`$spacing` or px: a bubble's leading top corner) and `maxWidth` (`$control`/`$spacing`, px or a percentage `"N%"` of the parent), so a theme sizes a macro's box (MessageBubble/bubble) without a macro change. #EXP-1629: Select gains `description` (a muted hint: under a `field` trigger as a form description; in a `row` trigger UNDER the label, the `labels` column holding both (its `gap`) and shrinking so the hint wraps (at most the layout's `selectRowDescriptionMaxWidth`), the value and chevron in the trailing `control` column (its `minWidth` and `gap`, the value end-aligned); a `row` trigger grows past its `minHeight` to hold them). #EXP-1629 (the multi picker): Select gains the `button` part: on a `row` trigger the `value` (else `placeholder`) and the `chevron` sit inside it, the IDE picker's ghost value button, so a theme fills only it under the pointer, and the painter mirrors its `hover` onto the value/placeholder/chevron inside it; a `multiple` Select opens with the cursor on the first CHOSEN enabled option (else the first enabled), a single one on the first enabled. #EXP-1629: Input `variant` gains `bare` and `code`, and Textarea gains the `variant` when-prop (`field`, `row`, `code`): a `bare`/`code` Input and a `row`/`code` Textarea draw no label (it stays the accessible name) and no chrome of their own (a field inside a Group row: the theme gives the insets); `code` sets the field in the mono code type.
